reason: I already take most orders on WhatsApp text and voice, and three months free with someone setting it up at my shop costs me nothing to try. I would sign up to test it, but I would only pay the 500 after the free months if it really gets my Hindi right.
objection: Will it understand my Hindi, my regional words and my item names? If it keeps mixing up items or udhaar amounts, I will be fixing its cards all day and it is useless to me.
would_change_my_mind: If the person who visits my shop tests it live on my own voice notes and my own item names and it gets them right, I would be fully in. If it gets them wrong in front of me, I would say no.
